overview_description.description: Powerus provides heavy-lift VTOL aircraft, tactical unmanned air systems, and autonomous maritime platforms designed for deployment in high-risk environments. Through its PowerAir and PowerSea divisions, Powerus supports missions involving asset transport, border security, offshore infrastructure protection, emergency response, and operational sustainment. Its platform integrates mission systems, enterprise air capabilities, maritime services, and training support under a unified operational framework.

about_short_description.short_description: Powerus develops autonomous systems architecture and unmanned platforms for defense, infrastructure, maritime, and industrial operations.

product.name: PowerAir
product.description: An autonomous air-systems portfolio combining heavy-lift VTOL aircraft, enterprise air platforms, and tactical unmanned systems for defense, emergency response, agriculture, and infrastructure operations.

product.name: Kaizen Aerospace xFold Heavy-Lift Systems
product.description: Industrial VTOL aircraft designed to transport payloads from approximately 100 to 1,000 pounds for logistics, infrastructure, emergency-response, and defense operations.

product.name: Tandem Defense Mission Systems
product.description: Modular tactical unmanned aerial systems for contested environments, including swarm-capable, fiber-optic, RF, interceptor, and autonomous configurations.

product.name: PowerSea
product.description: An autonomous maritime-systems portfolio comprising unmanned surface systems and maritime autonomy solutions for defense, border security, and offshore infrastructure protection.

product.name: Kaizen Aerospace xNav AI Platform
product.description: An autonomy and flight-operations system for xFold aircraft that supports decision-making, risk prediction, terrain following, obstacle avoidance, BVLOS operations, and fleet management.

product.name: Unified Autonomous Systems Architecture
product.description: A common modular architecture that standardizes control, power distribution, autonomy, communications, and payload integration across Powerus air and maritime systems.
